THIRD PARTY NOTICES
OpenPhantom installer
===============================================================================

Read this together with THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt beside it. That file came out
of the OpenPhantom patch archive and describes what is in that archive: the
patch itself and DxWrapper. This file describes everything else the installer
put on your machine.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. What the other file covers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt names the patch and DxWrapper, and says of libVLC
  and FFmpeg that neither is in the patch archive. Both are on this machine
  because this installer carried them, so they are described below.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. What the installer adds
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  libVLC                                                  GPL v2
    Files      mods\fmv\libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and mods\fmv\plugins\
    Copyright  VideoLAN and its contributors
    Source     https://www.videolan.org/vlc/
    Licence    mods\fmv\vlc-License.txt
    Unaltered. 33 of the 851 files in VideoLAN's own 32-bit build, being the
    ones needed to play one H.264 and AAC file into a window.

  FFmpeg                                                  GPL v3
    Files      mods\fmv\ffmpeg.exe
    Copyright  the FFmpeg developers
    Source     https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
    Licence    mods\fmv\ffmpeg-License.txt
    The build convert_movies.ps1 pins, gyan.dev's "essentials" build of FFmpeg
    9.0. It is GPL v3 rather than LGPL because it links x264 statically, so
    x264's source is part of the corresponding source for it.

  DSOAL                                                   LGPL v2.1
  OpenAL Soft                                             LGPL v2
    Files      dsound.dll, dsoal-aldrv.dll, alsoft.ini
    Copyright  Chris Robinson and contributors
    Source     https://github.com/kcat/dsoal
               https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft
    Licence    DSOAL-Licenses\, which holds DSOAL's licence and the four
               OpenAL Soft licence files
    Unaltered, from DSOAL's own archived build r694.

  Saved games
    Files      Save\ZANZI01.SAV to ZANZI11.SAV, if you chose them
    Made for this project by playing the game. Not taken from anywhere else,
    and covered by the project's own licence.

  dxwrapper.ini
    Seven settings differ from the file DxWrapper ships with its dx7.games
    build, all of them tuning this game rather than repairing DxWrapper:
    DdrawEmulateSurface, DdrawUseShadowSurface and DdrawEnableByteAlignment
    are 1 rather than 0, AnisotropicFiltering and DepthBiasFactor are 16
    rather than 0, and ForceVsyncMode and EnableVSync are 1 rather than 0.
    Everything else in the file is upstream's. The DxWrapper binaries themselves are unaltered.
    See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for DxWrapper's own terms.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. Getting the source
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  libVLC, DSOAL and OpenAL Soft are under the GPL and the LGPL, which require
  that the source accompany the binaries rather than merely be linked to. The
  release this installer came from carries all of it, pinned to the exact
  revisions these binaries were built from:

    vlc-3.0.23.tar.xz
    dsoal-r694-5c65e5fe.tar.gz
    openal-soft-r10633-2dc741b5.tar.gz
    ffmpeg-9.0-d32b387f2b.tar.gz
    x264-v0.165.3223-0480cb05.tar.gz

  If you received this installer without them, they are on the project's
  releases page, and the revisions and checksums are recorded in
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the installer's source repository.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. The game itself
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  No game data, executables, assets or other proprietary files are included in
  this installer. The game is copied from your own disc.

  This is an independent fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or
  sponsored by LucasArts, Lucasfilm Ltd or Disney. All trademarks and related
  intellectual property belong to their respective owners.
